name: Множественная продажа автомобилей одним пользователем [3] 3

testStage.description: Тест проверяет продажу нескольких автомобилей одним пользователем

steps.name: $("By.xpath: //*[th[contains(text(), 'Engine Type')] and th[contains(text(), 'Mark')]]/ancestor::table//tbody//td[3]/input") set value(Wisoky Inc)
$("By.xpath: //*[th[contains(text(), 'Engine Type')] and th[contains(text(), 'Mark')]]/ancestor::table//tbody//td[3]/input") should have(value="Wisoky Inc")
$("By.xpath: //*[th[contains(text(), 'Engine Type')] and th[contains(text(), 'Mark')]]/ancestor::table//tbody//td[4]/input") set value(Frank Bryce)
$("By.xpath: //*[th[contains(text(), 'Engine Type')] and th[contains(text(), 'Mark')]]/ancestor::table//tbody//td[4]/input") should have(value="Frank Bryce")
$("By.xpath: //*[th[contains(text(), 'Engine Type')] and th[contains(text(), 'Mark')]]/ancestor::table/parent::div//button[contains(@class, 'status')]") should not have(text "Status: not pushed")

parameters.name: car
parameters.value: Car(engineType=Hydrogenic, mark=Wisoky Inc, model=Frank Bryce, price=2845.34)
